verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents a full pull request workflow: diff comparison and inline feedback, stacked PRs with landing, rulesets requiring reviews and code-owner approval, and PR checks. However, nothing in the evidence mentions forking a repository or outside non-collaborators opening PRs from their own copies, which is the core of the story. missing for 10: documented fork capability, evidence that outside contributors without write access can submit PRs from forks, independent/hands-on corroboration
